nom: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Suractivated Hyaluronic Acid Anti-Aging Face Cream

avis.texte: Disclaimer: If you don't like scents, DO NOT purchase this. Move on. Click elsewhere. You will not be happy. I've had terrific results from this cream in a small amount of time - I bought this as a quick alternative to Clinique's Moisture Surge (I was traveling, didn't have time to wait for the Clinique to arrive), but I didn't think a "drug store brand" like LRP would deliver quick or worthwhile results, but, I proved myself wrong! This is a high quality product for a decent price point - worth every penny. I gave up on my Clinique moisturizer for this. It goes on smooth, absorbs rapidly into the skin, and unless I use too much, I've never once had an issue with oiliness or stickiness afterwards. My skin looks younger, firmer and hydrated and it stands up to brutally dry & cold weather. I haven't had any sort of reactions or issues with the formulation either - my super sensitive skin did quite well with it. About the scent: it is definitely *there* - it isn't faint at all, and at first, I'll admit I wasn't thrilled about it, but, after a couple of uses it grew on me - and now I kind of look forward to putting in on because of the scent. That said, I think it would be great if they came up with a scent free variety because not everyone can tolerate scents. Still, overall, 5-star product and a great alternative to Clinique.

I'm a recent convert to La Rouche- Posay. As in my other review this past winter I had issues with hydrating my skin especially around my mouth. This night cream did a good job combating the dryness where so many other creams failed. I will say that the other cream I ordered was more effective (it's in my reviews I can't remember it's exact name). But I would use this under my makeup, not at night, to keep my skin from "cracking" after hours passed. It has a lightweight clean scent to it. Nothing over powering. It of medium thickness and absorbs quickly. I have never had any irritation and it feels good and silky on the skin. It has lasted under my makeup all day- meaning 16 hours. I really like this cream, but alas I love another La Rouche Posay moisturizer even better so I probably won't reorder. Simply because I'm on hospice and I can find things that are better on my budget. But it does absolutely work wonderfully.

Ive been using this for 2months and the change in my skin and fine lines is insane!!! As we age our skin changes so much if I knew about this 20yrs ago im sure my skin would love me more now! Lightweight, non greasy, super moisturizing and a little goes a long way!!

avis.titre: Lightweight and perfect for combo skin
avis.texte: Favorite moisturizer cream! Helps my combo skin especially in my dry areas. Lightweight, non greasy at all. Subtle smell but pleasant. No white cast. Makes my skincare and makeup look so nice. This is my 3rd bottle and I’m obsess!

This cream is exceptional. I am in my late 60s and have been using an expensive product for many years, without noticeable results. I have been using this cream for only 2-3 weeks, and my skin is noticeably more dewy and healthy looking. As others have mentioned, I don’t love the scent, but it’s not a deal breaker for this wonderful cream.

I never find moisturizers that work for me, but I've had decent luck with La Roche-Posay products in the past, so I took a chance. I'm on my second jar, which has literally never happened to me before. It relieved my dry skin, without causing me to break out. It's got a lightweight gel cream consistently and absorbs easily. If it has a scent, I couldn't tell. Works great under makeup.

avis.titre: Hilft bisher am besten - besser als Citaplast B5

Zu beginn half es und dann nicht mehr, hatte immer wurde stärkeren Juckreiz. Mit der Hyalu B5 Creme war es am besten und der Juckreiz war fast weg. Geheilt hat es die Creme nicht aber sie tat unfassbar gut. Sie hat reizende Inhaltsstoffe aber meine Haut hat sie gut vertragen :) Sie fühlt sich eher gut an.

I decided to try these products because they are highly recommended, but I was very disappointed with the way they arrived. The boxes did not have any type of safety seal or stickers to prove that the products were new and had not been opened and returned by other customers. This makes me feel uncomfortable about the hygiene and safety of the products. Additionally, I used the three products in this order: serum, cream, and sunscreen, but they did not absorb into my skin. Instead, they started peeling and forming little flakes on my face. I am going to try using them separately and will update my review later.

Excellent line of products and like the results from continued use, but the jar is glass and was shipped in a non-padded paper mailer. It arrived obviously damaged & when opened saw the jar lid screwed on at an angle--wasn't sure if opened & returned or a blow to the package during shipping caused it to arrive that way. No confidence in its cleanliness with the jar slightly open. Returned it without issue and refund returned to my account. Will purchase from other sources now.

avis.titre: Hydrates like a dream, just wish it came fragrance-free.
avis.texte: This cream is like that friend who shows up slightly overdressed but is *incredibly* supportive. The Hyalu B5 Suractivated Cream is super moisturizing without feeling heavy or greasy—my skin drinks it up and then politely asks for seconds. It feels light, smooth, and makes my face feel bouncy and hydrated instead of sad and dry. Now, the only reason it’s not a full 5 stars: the fragrance. It has a mild, perfume-like scent that I personally could live without. It’s not overpowering, but my sensitive-nose self would prefer “no scent, just vibes.” Thankfully, it fades quickly and doesn’t irritate my skin. Overall, if you want hydration that works hard while feeling weightless, this cream delivers. Knocked off half a star for the scent, but my skin is still very much in love.
